database_scope_cautions.details: The primary source characterizes BacCH91 as a lantibiotic and figure evidence supports the mature sequence letters, while APD6/DRAMP/CAMP/dbAMP rows encode a plain one-letter sequence or omit modification fields.

Database labels such as Anti-Gram+ or Gram-positive are supported by Table 2 only at category level; final activity rows preserve target-by-target MIC values, including the L. lactis and Gram-negative non-susceptibility limits.

No hemolysis/cytotoxicity values were recovered from XML, article PDF text, or supplementary PDF text. Linked database notes that omit toxicity are retained as no-data statements, not converted into negative assay results.
